courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鐵路隧道疏散步道
related.transfer: 可遷移「檢修工位利用率」與「檢查面照明分布」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鐵路隧道疏散步道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Utilization of maintenance bays" and "Lighting on inspection surfaces" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦機廠資源配置檢修節拍與安全動線；鐵路隧道疏散步道則以隧道步道連續性照明與協助疏散為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on depot resources maintenance cycles and safe movement paths; Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels centres on tunnel-walkway continuity lighting and assisted evacuation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「檢修工位利用率」與「步道距離與協助時間」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鐵路隧道疏散步道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「下車匯流區密度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Utilization of maintenance bays” and “Walkway distance and assistance time”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Evacuation walkways in railway tunnels, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Density in alighting merge areas", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鐵路機廠檢修動線
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2010 年機械風險評估方法的該版標準發布。；2015 年品質管理方法的二零一五版發布。；2023 年機械安全控制設計方法更新版發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對機廠資源配置檢修節拍與安全動線而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用車輛移交完整週期及檢修驗證工時計畫連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2010: This edition of machinery risk-assessment guidance was published. 2015: The twenty-fifteen edition of quality-management requirements was published. 2023: An updated machinery safety-control design edition was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For depot resources maintenance cycles and safe movement paths, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through complete vehicle-handoff cycle and planning maintenance verification effort. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
